WITH film_filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    rental_rate / rental_duration AS cost_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
),
rating_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(cost_per_day) AS avg_cost_per_day
  FROM film_filtered
  GROUP BY rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_cost_per_day) AS overall_mean
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT 
  r.rating,
  r.avg_cost_per_day,
  r.avg_cost_per_day - o.overall_mean AS above_mean
FROM rating_averages r
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE r.avg_cost_per_day > o.overall_mean
ORDER BY r.rating;
